description: Remove an organisation egress allowlist entry, revoking trust in its outbound destination and potentially breaking integrations that use it. Inspect get_egress_allowlist_entry first. Deletion cannot be undone by this tool. Returns Portkey's acknowledgement or HTTP 404; requires organisation permission.

id.description: Egress allowlist entry UUID from list_egress_allowlist or create_egress_allowlist_entry

name: delete_egress_allowlist_entry
